{{Quote|In your early years, the flow of the Force might seem frightening, shocking. Find Balance between its light and dark facets, and the flow will become a powerful stillness. Struggle against the Force, and your body rebels; fight with the Force and you have the universe on your side.|Vor'Dana|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>}}
'''Vor'Dana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Je'daii Temple Master]] of [[Stav Kesh]] serving the [[Je'daii Order]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] circa [[26,012 BBY]].

==Biography==
Vor'Dana was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Forceful]] member of the Je'daii Order on Tython. Appointed Temple Master of Stav Kesh, he condemned the practice of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemy]], thinking that this art was too dangerous for the emotional balance of a Je'daii. During his time as Temple Master, Vor'Dana was said to have slain thirteen [[Sand Assassin]]s within the Grand Hall of the Temple.
